records.title: M3-T11-164 — Three-face edge-LCM amplification and R-free tau router
records.content:
﻿M3-T11-164 — Three-face edge-LCM amplification and R-free tau router


CARD_ID: M3-T11-164
CANONICAL_CARD_KEY: M3-T11-164
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT_THREE_FACE_LCM_ROUTER / LARGE_C_OR_LFREE_BRANCH_OPEN
GLOBAL_OPERATION: ACTIVE_T11_RESEARCH_WITH_SCOPED_DECOMPOSITION
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001, OPEN
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
AUDIT_MODE: WITHIN_SESSION_NOT_INDEPENDENT


1. Current decision and sources


Current MAIN, CARD-INDEX, RESULT-LEDGER, active ROUTE, M3-T11-163 and the needed retained cards M3-T11-004/005/006/007/013 were read. CARD-INDEX searches for edge lcm / least common multiple / six reduced legs / gcd(lcm,R) / R-free / edge-exclusive found no prior card containing the exact invariant below. M3-ODD-001 concerns the unique odd physical edge as an lcm of Master source legs; it is a distinct coordinate.


This card does not close the endpoint count. It converts the 163 three-face interior into an exact simultaneous physical router and removes one redundant bookkeeping condition.


2. Primitive edge gcd decomposition and the six-leg product


Let (e1,e2,e3) be the positive primitive endpoint edges, gcd(e1,e2,e3)=1. Put
g12=gcd(e1,e2), g13=gcd(e1,e3), g23=gcd(e2,e3).


The three gij are pairwise coprime: any common prime divisor of two of them would divide all three edges.


Hence there are positive integers a1,a2,a3 with
e1=g12*g13*a1,
e2=g12*g23*a2,
e3=g13*g23*a3.


The two primitive legs on each reduced physical face are therefore
face12: g13*a1, g23*a2,
face13: g12*a1, g23*a3,
face23: g12*a2, g13*a3.


Their product is
(g13 a1)(g23 a2)(g12 a1)(g23 a3)(g12 a2)(g13 a3)
=(g12*g13*g23*a1*a2*a3)^2.


Primewise, because min(v_p(e1),v_p(e2),v_p(e3))=0, one checks
v_p(g12*g13*g23*a1*a2*a3)=max_i v_p(e_i).
Therefore, with
L := lcm(e1,e2,e3),
we have the exact identity


PRODUCT OF THE SIX REDUCED FACE LEGS = L^2.


This is a three-face identity; no independence of faces is used.


3. Consequence for the 163 interior and correction to the 161 bookkeeping


Let ell_ij be the shorter of the two primitive legs on face ij, as in M3-T11-163. If all three faces satisfy
ell_ij > E,
then all six reduced face legs are >E. The product identity gives


L > E^3.


Equivalently, every endpoint with L<=E^3 has at least one face with ell_ij<=E and is therefore already charged by M3-T11-163.


Thus, using retained010/160 through 163,
#{endpoint: L<=Z} <= Z^(1/3) B^o(1)
for 1<=Z<=B^3, after putting E=Z^(1/3) (integer rounding is harmless).


For Z=B^(1-3delta), fixed delta>0, this sector is o(M3).


Bookkeeping correction: on one primitive face with short leg ell, long leg ell+d and hypotenuse p,
p^2 = ell^2+(ell+d)^2
    = 2ell^2+2ell*d+d^2.
Hence outside the 162 and 163 sectors,
ell>E and d>D imply
p > sqrt(2E^2+2ED+D^2).


In particular, at the standard equal cutoffs T=D=E, the condition p>T is automatic once ell>E (indeed p>ell>E), so M3-T11-161 is redundant in the final equal-cutoff residual. This does NOT retract the theorem of161; it corrects only the combined bookkeeping. The live equal-cutoff core may be written simply as
all three ell_ij>E AND all three d_ij>D.
The previous extra phrase “all p_ij>T” is true but redundant.


4. Exact bridge from edge LCM to the retained h_i / tau structure


Retain the M3-T11-004 notation
h_i=gcd(R,e_i),
H:=h1*h2*h3,
tau=R/H,
c1=h2*h3, c2=h1*h3, c3=h1*h2.


If a prime p divides R and two different edges, then from
R^2=e1^2+e2^2+e3^2
it divides the third edge as well, contradicting gcd(e1,e2,e3)=1. Therefore, for every p|R, at most one edge has positive p-valuation.


Primewise this gives the exact identity
H = gcd(L,R).


Define the R-free edge-LCM factor
L_free := L/H.
Then
tau = R/H,
gcd(L_free,tau)=1.


Moreover
L_free = lcm(e1/h1, e2/h2, e3/h3).
Indeed, the p-adic exponent on either side is max_i max(v_p(e_i)-min(v_p(e_i),v_p(R)),0).


Thus the old common residual tau and the new three-face edge-LCM have the same removed common factor H:
L = H*L_free,
R = H*tau,
gcd(L_free,tau)=1,
and L_free/tau = L/R.


5. Large-cross-gcd versus large R-free edge-LCM router


Because
c1*c2*c3 = (h2h3)(h1h3)(h1h2)=H^2,
if max_i c_i<=C then
H<=C^(3/2).


On the 163 interior L>E^3, the same branch therefore forces
L_free = L/H > E^3/C^(3/2).


Consequently every endpoint outside the 162/163 small sectors lies in at least one of the following branches:


A. some cyclic raw-edge cross-gcd c_i > C; this is the existing Stage14CrossGcdStratifiedRawEdgeTail branch already isolated in M3-T11-013 and earlier XG cards;


B. all c_i<=C and
   L_free > E^3/C^(3/2),
   with gcd(L_free,tau)=1.


This is an exact same-endpoint router. It does not multiply three c_i probabilities.


At the standard scales
E=B^(1/3-delta),
C=B^(1/6+xi),
branch B satisfies
L_free > B^(3/4 - 3delta - (3/2)xi).


So once the existing large-c_i branch is controlled at its historical B^(1/6+xi) threshold, the whole remaining three-face interior is forced into a genuinely large R-free edge-LCM conductor, near the three-quarter power scale for small delta,xi.


6. Additional tau consequence on the small-c branch


Put
u_i=e_i/h_i.
The primitive space triangle opposite edge i has leg u_i and hypotenuse
D_i=R/h_i=c_i*tau.
Hence, when all c_i<=C,
u_i < C*tau.


Since
L_free=lcm(u1,u2,u3)<=u1*u2*u3,
we get
L_free < C^3*tau^3.


Combining with the lower bound above yields
tau > E/C^(3/2).


At the standard scales,
tau > B^(1/12 - delta - (3/2)xi).


This is weaker than the large-R amplification of M3-T11-013 when its R>B^(2/3-eta) hypothesis is available; on that branch 013 still gives the stronger
tau > B^(5/12 - eta - (3/2)xi).
The new point is that the L_free lower bound and coprimality with tau hold without a large-R assumption.


7. Verification and audit limits


The six-leg product identity was exhaustively checked for all 104527 ordered primitive positive triples (e1,e2,e3) with 1<=e_i<=50.


Among these, 774 triples also satisfy e1^2+e2^2+e3^2=R^2 for an integer R. On every such synthetic primitive space-diagonal triple, the following were checked exactly:
H=product_i gcd(R,e_i)=gcd(L,R);
L_free=L/H;
tau=R/H;
gcd(L_free,tau)=1;
L_free=lcm(e1/h1,e2/h2,e3/h3).


These finite checks validate the algebraic adapters only. They are not perfect-cuboid examples, do not enumerate physical endpoints, and do not prove a counting theorem. The infinite statements above follow from the primewise arguments.


8. Handoff


LATEST_RESEARCH_CARD=M3-T11-164
NEXT_CANDIDATE=M3-T11-165
CURRENT_ATTACK=LargeRFreeEdgeLCMPhysicalSupportOrExistingCrossGcdTail


Current equal-cutoff endpoint decomposition:
P(B) <= P_near(B;D) + P_axis(B;E) + P_core(B;D,E),
where the first two terms are o(M3) for D=E=B^(1/3-delta), and P_core has all three d_ij>D and ell_ij>E.


For any C, P_core splits exactly into:
(A) some c_i>C, the existing same-measure raw-edge cross-gcd tail gate;
(B) max c_i<=C, hence L_free>E^3/C^(3/2), gcd(L_free,tau)=1, and tau>E/C^(3/2).


At C=B^(1/6+xi), the new branch has
L_free>B^(3/4-3delta-(3/2)xi).


Next research should either:
- attach an actual same-measure count to this large L_free physical support; or
- combine the large coprime pair (L_free,tau) with an existing exact physical coordinate such as the odd-edge/divisor chart without replacing the endpoint measure by an ambient divisor count.
Do not count fixed L_free values independently and sum a B^o fiber bound over its full B^3 ambient range; that loses the required power. Do not multiply neighboring c_i or tau appearances as independent savings.


NEW_THREE_FACE_EXACT_ROUTER=true
NEW_GLOBAL_ENDPOINT_BOUND=false
P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0
TI=PARKED
120=RETRACTED
147-149=FROZEN

records.title: M3-T11-163 — Summed short primitive-leg endpoint sector
records.content:
﻿M3-T11-163 — Summed short primitive-leg endpoint sector


CARD_ID: M3-T11-163
CANONICAL_CARD_KEY: M3-T11-163
STATUS: PROVED_ENDPOINT_SECTOR_USING_RETAINED010 / INTERIOR_COMPLEMENT_OPEN
GLOBAL_OPERATION: ACTIVE_T11_RESEARCH_WITH_SCOPED_DECOMPOSITION
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001, OPEN
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
AUDIT_MODE: WITHIN_SESSION_NOT_INDEPENDENT


1. Current decision and scope


Current MAIN, CARD-INDEX, RESULT-LEDGER, active ROUTE, M3-T11-162 and the needed retained cards 010/160/161 were read. CARD-INDEX search for “small leg”, “primitive leg”, “min leg”, “extreme ratio”, “skinny face”, “small coordinate” and “short leg” found no prior card for the statistic below. This is a scoped new endpoint-sector bound, not a global endpoint bound and not a literature-wide novelty claim.


For a principal first-cover state at exact R<=B, reduce its missing-face legs by
g=gcd(C,X), c=C/g, x=X/g, p=sqrt(c^2+x^2)<=B.
The pair (c,x) is primitive. Define its primitive short-leg statistic
ell=min(c,x)=min(C,X)/gcd(C,X).


Let A_axis(B,E) be the number of ORDERED primitive positive Pythagorean directions with p<=B and ell<=E. Let r_axis(B;E) count original H_F class1 first-cover states with ell<=E, preserving all physical parents, lifts, contents and original masks. Let P_axis(B;E) count primitive canonical endpoints for which at least one of the three reduced face pairs has ell_ij<=E.


2. Complete moving-family direction count


Fix ell>=1 and suppose the other primitive leg is x>=ell.


If ell is odd, the primitive triple has x even and p odd. Then
(p-x)(p+x)=ell^2.
Both factors are positive odd integers. Every triple with this fixed ell determines a factor pair u*v=ell^2, u<v, via
u=p-x, v=p+x,
and conversely the factor pair determines
p=(u+v)/2, x=(v-u)/2.
Primitivity and x>=ell can only remove factor pairs. Hence the number of unordered primitive directions with short leg ell is at most tau(ell^2).


If ell is even, it is the even leg of the primitive triple, while x and p are odd. Put
u=(p-x)/2, v=(p+x)/2.
Then u,v are positive integers and
u*v=ell^2/4.
Again a factor pair determines (p,x), so the number is at most tau(ell^2/4)<=tau(ell^2).


Allowing both leg orders costs at most a factor 2. Therefore, uniformly for 1<=E<=B,
A_axis(B,E) <= 2 sum_{ell<=E} tau(ell^2).


For every eta>0 the elementary divisor bound tau(n)<<_eta n^(eta/2) gives tau(ell^2)<<_eta ell^eta after renaming eta. Consequently
A_axis(B,E) <<_eta E^(1+eta) <= E B^eta.
Equivalently,
A_axis(B,E) = E B^o(1)
uniformly for E<=B.
No fixed-leg constant, moving direction family, content, lift or physical parent multiplicity is hidden in this arithmetic family sum.


3. Transfer to the original physical endpoint measure


Each ordered primitive direction fixes exactly one reduced physical ratio rho=C/X. Retained M3-T11-010 gives, for every eta>0, one uniform K_eta such that
m_rho(B) <= K_eta B^eta
for every physical rational ratio rho, with contents/lifts already included.


Thus
r_axis(B;E) <= B^o(1) A_axis(B,E) <= E B^o(1).


For a canonical endpoint with some ell_ij<=E, choose a face attaining the minimum ell_ij, breaking ties in canonical face order. Use the complementary edge as the shared edge. Retained M3-T11-160 gives the corresponding principal physical first-cover state; the original parent is retained. Exactly as in the deterministic charging used in M3-T11-161/162, this is injective at parent level up to the retained fixed chart constant. Hence
P_axis(B;E) <= E B^o(1).


For every fixed 0<delta<1/3, take
E=floor(B^(1/3-delta)).
Choosing the subpower exponent smaller than delta and using the retained lower bound
M3(B) >> B^(1/3)
gives
P_axis(B;E)/M3(B) -> 0.


This is an all-family/all-content endpoint SECTOR bound dependent on retained010 and the retained physical charging of160. It does not control the complementary endpoints.


4. This sector is genuinely additional to 161 and 162


For every odd ell>=3,
(ell, (ell^2-1)/2, (ell^2+1)/2)
is a primitive Pythagorean triple. Its short leg is ell, its primitive hypotenuse is asymptotic to ell^2/2, and its reduced leg difference is
(ell^2-2ell-1)/2,
also asymptotic to ell^2/2.


Thus at equal cutoffs T=D=E, large odd ell<=E gives arithmetic directions in the new short-leg sector while p>T and d>D. For E=B^(1/3-delta), these examples still have p=O(B^(2/3-2delta))<B for large B. This proves non-containment at the arithmetic-direction level. It does NOT assert that any member of this family is occupied by a full physical endpoint.


5. Combined endpoint decomposition and exact residual


Use disjoint bookkeeping in this order:
(1) charge M3-T11-161 endpoints with some primitive face hypotenuse p_ij<=T;
(2) among the rest, charge M3-T11-162 endpoints with some reduced leg difference d_ij<=D;
(3) among the rest, charge M3-T11-163 endpoints with some primitive short leg ell_ij<=E.


Let P_core(B;T,D,E) be the remaining original endpoints. Then
P(B) <= P_short(B;T) + P_near(B;D) + P_axis(B;E) + P_core(B;T,D,E),
and every endpoint in P_core satisfies on all three faces simultaneously
p_ij>T,
d_ij>D,
ell_ij>E.


At T=D=E=B^(1/3-delta), the first three terms are o(M3). The core remains OPEN. This is not a proof of P(B)/M3(B)->0, does not improve E_bal by itself, and does not permit multiplying independent face densities.


6. Verification and audit limits


A complete finite replay enumerated every primitive Pythagorean triple with p<=200000: 31819 unordered triples. For E=10,50,100,300,1000, direct Euclid enumeration of triples with min leg<=E matched exactly the reconstruction from the fixed-leg factor equations above, with counts
5,42,100,366,1246.
For the same E values, the crude envelopes sum_{ell<=E} tau(ell^2) were
48,470,1194,4984,22502,
respectively, so every exact count lay below the stated divisor envelope.


The finite replay checks the arithmetic adapter only. Physical endpoints enumerated=0. The asymptotic theorem follows from the factorization argument plus retained010/160, not from finite data. Audit is within-session, not an independent external hostile audit.


7. Handoff


LATEST_RESEARCH_CARD=M3-T11-163
NEXT_CANDIDATE=M3-T11-164
CURRENT_ATTACK=PrincipalInteriorThreeFaceSupportOrRatioIncidence


The residual is now the three-face interior:
all p_ij>T, all d_ij>D, all ell_ij>E.
The next useful step should exploit simultaneous three-face physical incidence/coupling, or another summable geometric statistic whose full moving-family/content cost is paid. Do not obtain “progress” by merely introducing another arbitrary one-face cutoff without a new summable mechanism. The separate M3-A-001 correlation receiver remains available and is not declared exhausted.


NEW_ENDPOINT_SECTOR_BOUND=true
NEW_GLOBAL_ENDPOINT_BOUND=false
PRINCIPAL_CLASS_GLOBALLY_CONTROLLED=false
P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0
TI=PARKED
120=RETRACTED
147-149=FROZEN
